_about: The App Store accessibility labels M1K3 claims, per device family, read by accessibility.py (#834). declare = the 1.5 TestFlight walk confirmed it; pending = evidence but no walk yet; no = not claimed. accessibility.py set --confirm refuses while anything chosen is pending. Flip a line only with the walk's result in its evidence.

voiceover.evidence: Kev walked TestFlight build 553 (1.5.0) by hand, 2026-11-15: pass ("All walked pal"). Before the walk: #829 named 24 unnamed controls; #831 fixed the Mac audit's findings. Owed: the common tasks by hand (ask, read the answer, Memories, Documents, Settings, onboarding).

voiceControl.evidence: Kev walked TestFlight build 553 (1.5.0) by hand, 2026-11-15: pass ("All walked pal"). Before the walk: Owed: Show names matches the visible labels on the composer, memory search, sidebar and toolbar.

darkInterface.evidence: Kev walked TestFlight build 553 (1.5.0) by hand, 2026-11-15: pass ("All walked pal"). Before the walk: Follows the system appearance. Owed: nothing unreadable in dark.

sufficientContrast.evidence: Kev walked TestFlight build 553 (1.5.0) by hand, 2026-11-15: pass ("All walked pal"). Before the walk: #831 measured light and dark: lowest 4.8:1 dark, 5.6:1 light. Owed: the walk's eye check.

largerText.evidence: Kev walked TestFlight build 553 (1.5.0) by hand, 2026-11-15: pass ("All walked pal"). Before the walk: #820 added the reading size setting. Owed: the largest size on the chat, Memories and Settings.

reducedMotion.evidence: Kev walked TestFlight build 553 (1.5.0) by hand, 2026-11-15: pass ("All walked pal"). Before the walk: Not audited. Owed: the avatar and voice animations with Reduce Motion on.

differentiateWithoutColorAlone.evidence: Kev walked TestFlight build 553 (1.5.0) by hand, 2026-11-15: pass ("All walked pal"). Before the walk: Not audited. Owed: any state shown by colour only.

captions.evidence: No video of its own. Spoken answers are always on screen as text, which is not Apple's Captions label (Kev's call to revisit).

voiceover.evidence: Kev walked TestFlight build 553 (1.5.0) by hand, 2026-11-15: pass ("All walked pal"). Before the walk: #829 and #832 fixed the iPhone audit's findings. Owed: the common tasks by hand; the combined Documents row reads title then date, and swipe-to-delete still works.
